title: Jamaican Energy Bites
description: A delicious and energizing snack made with Jamaican spices, perfect for a quick pick-me-up. These bite-sized treats are easy to make and can be customized to fit your dietary needs.

ingredients.name: energizing
ingredients.notes: any type of energizing ingredient (e.g. oats, nuts, seeds)

ingredients.name: jamaican
ingredients.notes: Jamaican spice blend or jerk seasoning

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the energizing ingredients, Jamaican spice blend, and minced garlic.
Mix well until everything is fully incorporated.
Scoop the mixture into the ramekin and press it down firmly to create a compact shape.
Place the ramekin on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove the ramekin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Once cool enough to handle, remove the energy bite from the ramekin and place it on a plate.
